verdicts.reason: A: the card fills almost the whole canvas, so the leaf imagery is gone; the bottle is jammed against the left edge and cut by the card border; the 'NEW NIGHT SERUM' eyebrow ends up bottom-left under the logo, out of reading order; and the four loose columns don't group. B keeps the leaf-and-bottle panel and a clear headline → body → CTA flow, but the CTA nearly touches the end of the headline, and the logo plus the 'NEW NIGHT SERUM' eyebrow are shrunk to tiny, barely legible text at the bottom, which weakens the brand.
